content.text: Adults = tx of coagulopathy w/ vit K supp; 10mg dose
Newborns = prophylactic administration of parenteral vit K
: vWF-containing factor VIII product (DDAVP USU ineffective in type 2; contraindicated in 2B)
: administered w/ in addition to vWF concentrates or DDVAP to suppress fibrinolysis
: 0.3 μg/kg infused over 20 min increases factor VIII levels 2- to 3-fold in most, but ⍉all, mild-mod hemophilia A pts
Required for bleed in the gums, GIT, & during oral surg
Tx w/ factor VIIa or porcine factor VIII
After acute bleed = controlled → tx w/
Recombinate, Advate, Kogenate FS, Elocate, Adynovate
Tx in those who have factor VIII inhibitors
: coag factor IX (recombinant), Fc fusion protein
For control/prev of bleed episodes & to mgnt perioperative bleed during surg procedures
: coag factor X (human) – 1st and only specific factor X replace therapy for hereditary factor X deficiency in pts ≥12yo for on-demand tx and control of bleed episodes and for perioperative mgnt
: saturates the Fc receptors on mononuclear cells and decreases destruction of opsonized PLT by macrophages
: alternate to IVIG; immunosuppressive that decreases autoantibody prod
TPO-r agonist for pts w/ chronic liver dz prior to undergoing a procedure:
Specific direct thrombin inhibitor therapy for short-term anticoagulation (until platelet count returns to norm & warfarin can be started)
: a vWF-directed Ab fragment for tx of adults w acquired TTP (aTTP), in combo w plasma exchg and immunosuppressive therapy; recombinant DNA product
: mild cutaneous vasodilate, facial flushing, tachy, HA, potential for dilutional hyponatremia
